_readme: Curated official-source discovery hubs per service (Freshness V2 §19). Seeds are chosen from evidence gathered in earlier phases: each is a policy/FAQ/rules/forms hub that has actually served corpus content or policy documents. Deliberately NOT included: entire ministry homepages (noisy), case/order archives (PII), login/application dashboards, search pages with uncontrolled pagination. epassport and bdris have no seeds because every known official host for them blocks automated acquisition (Akamai 403 on epassport.gov.bd; 403 headless-blocking on bdris.gov.bd and robots/TLS failures on orgbdr.gov.bd) — a discovery seed there would fail every run (V2 §22 keeps that safe, but it is pure noise).

discovery_seeds.purpose: NID portal FAQ index — the source of 54 corpus records; detects newly published citizen questions/answers
NBR official FAQ hub — the source of 81 ereturn corpus records; detects newly published tax FAQs and policy pages
Special Branch immigration rules hub — hosts Visa Policy 2026, visa forms and immigration rules; detects new policy circulars and forms

epassport._note: no usable hub: www.epassport.gov.bd serves an Akamai bot wall to automated clients; manual screenshots remain the fallback for that service

bdris._note: no usable hub: bdris.gov.bd 403s headless browsers, orgbdr.gov.bd is robots-disallowed/TLS-broken; manual screenshots remain the fallback
